The width and the height are linked, so the card keeps its proportion.
• The proportion is the relation between the width and the height of the card. The width is always %1$s times the height.
• When you change one side, the other side changes by itself. The card is never stretched.
• The original size is %2$s x %3$s mm. It is the size that lets 10 cards fit on one portrait A4 sheet, in 2 columns and 5 rows.
